lines: The sun is gone, the sky turns grey,
the first star rises, clear and bright.
We shuffle closer to the fire,
Fire in the night, sparks up in the air,
Fire in the night, the day has gone somewhere,
and the night joins in our song.
The tea is hot, the biscuits gone,
the smoke has settled in your coat.
We carry on from song to song,
until the last one clears their throat.
And when the fire burns down to red,
the song is still inside our head.
Fire in the night, sparks up in the air,
Fire in the night, the day has gone somewhere,
and the night joins in our song.
